title: Mobile landing and signup flow hardening
goal: Make the public landing and signup journey clear, compact, touch-friendly, and overflow-free at phone widths

in: Public root landing-page hierarchy and responsive layout
Presentation-only responsive options for the embedded auth card
Phone touch targets, safe-area spacing, overflow, and reduced-motion behavior
out: Authenticated application navigation and domain dashboards

acceptance_criteria: The first phone viewport presents one value proposition and one obvious account path
Header and CTA controls remain distinct, touch-friendly, and collision-free from 320px upward
The landing page has no horizontal overflow at phone, tablet, or desktop widths
Repeated marketing sections and duplicate calls to action are removed
The embedded auth card is readable and comfortably padded on phones without changing auth behavior

commands: browser viewport, overflow, interaction, and accessibility checks

progress.summary: Expanded from public landing-only hardening to the shared authenticated mobile chrome after the owner clarified that the request covers the overall mobile experience. The global nav currently crowds 6-7 actions into the phone header while the player is already offset for a missing 64px bottom bar.
next_steps: Add a compact phone header, persistent five-action bottom navigation, and matching content/player spacing without changing desktop or venue/admin navigation.
